purpose: Document first-party Marabá municipal cadastral-source discovery and bounded anonymous access review.
assessment: A local municipal cadastral custodian and property-registry procedure were evidenced. The official public IPTU/Cadastro Imobiliário portal was reachable in indexed results but is a lookup workflow requiring an inscription and visual code; no anonymous safe parcel ID-plus-geometry response, schema, CRS, viewer configuration, or public map API was verified. No polygon is retained. Runtime remains held.
